prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of OCEANUS. Oceanus in full coiling fish-tailed form towering over the earth-encircling freshwater current.
ANATOMY: ONE male deity, one head and two eyes, TWO clearly readable bull horns, TWO human arms, human upper torso covered in opaque antique dark bronze cloth, ONE very long coiling serpentine fish tail ending in a fish fin; NO human legs or trident. [oceanus-c08, oceanus-c12]
MOMENT: Surge diagonally upward from the stream, his powerful fish tail sweeping across the immediate foreground in one great curve while both hands press toward the oncoming water; face fierce and unmistakable above the wave.
POWER: Massive waves physically rear and fold around his tail as he stops a passage, spray and heavy water sheets. [oceanus-c27]
SCALE & CAMERA: Broad full-body diagonal composition from extreme low river-bank camera; foreground tail large and foreshortened, his torso and face still occupy upper half. The curving stream is secondary to the complete being, no small distant god.
LIGHT & WEATHER: Single warm sunset horizon behind his horn silhouette, shadowed scaled tail with reflected bronze light.
SURFACE: rich tactile cloth, fur, scales or stone appropriate to the specified anatomy, wet water surfaces and physical dust only where mentioned.
SETTING: The freshwater river encircling earth, its immense curve visible behind his body on the western edge; no modern globe icon, labels or space diagram. [oceanus-c02, oceanus-c04, oceanus-c24]
MOOD: imposing, overwhelming, awe-inspiring or menacing as appropriate to the source; figure and identifying features instantly legible at 200 pixels; never cute, calm, decorative or an ordinary person or animal.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: ONE square image, premium painterly cinematic illustration with tactile brushwork rather than glossy photoreal fashion rendering; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame, watermark, nudity, gore, extra heads, limbs, fingers or duplicated anatomy; no film, game, anime or comic design, no neon outline, generic glow aura, magic ribbons or floating runes. Every effect must belong to the cited deed; environmental lighting is artistic presentation.
depicted_variant: Oceanus in full coiling fish-tailed form towering over the earth-encircling freshwater current.
